settings.heading: How can we help?
settings.subheading: Email orders@caratforus.com or use the form. Include an order or reference number where you have one.

settings.title: For the fastest help
settings.text: Email orders@caratforus.com or use the form. Include the applicable order or reference number so we can find you.

settings.title: What to include
settings.items:
An existing order — your order number
A return — order number and what is wrong
A warranty claim — order number and photographs
A Group Buy — the campaign and your order reference
Custom Jewelry — your project or submission reference

settings.title: When you will hear back
settings.text: A person here replies by email. Returns, warranty claims and questions are handled by the same company that sold you the piece.
